name: Florida Gas Transmission Phase III Expansion
researcher_notes: Not an existing row: GEM has Phase IV through VIII and many other FGT projects, but no Phase III. An Oil and Gas Journal story from February 28, 1994 says Florida Gas Transmission picked contractors for the Phase III expansion. It says 815 miles of 36, 30, 26 inch and smaller line in Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama and Florida, 530 MMcf/d, and a 900 million dollar cost, with 320 million dollars in contracts let. The 815 miles is stated as pipelaying, so it may include loops and laterals. A Federal Register notice of September 10, 1996 (FERC rate filing) refers to the Phase III system as in service and says actual construction costs were greater than estimated. This supports operating status. The exact in-service year (1995 per the consolidator) was not confirmed from a source, so no start year is staged. Diameter list 26, 30, 36 is from the story; smaller sizes are not given. Single independent source for the quantities, so medium. Owner spelled as the gazetteer entity. No route found; route research not done. Capacity is incremental. A hathitrust catalog record exists for the FERC environmental impact statement (https://catalog.hathitrust.org/Record/100932332), a possible further source.
